summary: The school district expresses strong opposition to any proposal to sunset or eliminate the E-Rate program, emphasizing the essential role of broadband in modern public education and the potential impact on their budget and operations. They urge the FCC to preserve and strengthen the program rather than reduce its role in public education. The text urges protection of E-Rate and its role in providing connectivity for education.

claims.argument: Federal Communications Commission should reject any proposal to sunset or eliminate the E-Rate program
claims.evidence_quote: I therefore respectfully urge the Commission to: Reject any proposal to sunset or eliminate the E-Rate program; Reject proposals that would unnecessarily narrow E-Rate eligibility or restrict support based solely on geography or other criteria that would leave students without adequate support; Preserve support for the connectivity and internal network infrastructure schools need to provide reliable educational access; and Work with schools and other stakeholders to strengthen and modernize E-Rate rather than reduce its role in public education.

claims.argument: E-Rate has enabled schools to build connectivity necessary for modern education
claims.evidence_quote: E-Rate has enabled schools (public and private) and libraries to build and maintain the connectivity necessary for students and patrons to participate fully in modern education. As our nation seeks to prepare students for college, careers, and an increasingly technology-driven economy, now is not the time to undermine the very program and related infrastructure that makes those opportunities possible.
